clue.text: Fantastic writer inspired by academic I disregarded

indicators.note: something breathed in sits inside, so the writer goes within the academic word
the I is ignored, so it drops out of the academic word

parts.note: studious means given to study, bookish
a pen is a writing instrument, standing for the writer

explanation.surface: A wonderful author is drawn into university life, though one personal touch is overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something astonishing or marvellous, so they are synonyms in the sense of amazingly good.

clue.text: Is this the point of Dynasty?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the pointed tongue of a blade fitting into its handle
second meaning: the ... dynasty ruled China from 618 to 907

explanation.surface: A question about whether something is the whole purpose of the TV soap Dynasty.
explanation.walkthrough: Dynasty looks like the American soap opera; here it is the Chinese ruling house.
explanation.definitionFit: A tang is the projecting spike of a tool or knife, and Tang is the name of a celebrated Chinese imperial line.

clue.text: World to which Zoopla network contributes all its needs

indicators.note: the two clue words between them supply every letter required, a run of consecutive letters across them

parts.note: the letters run straight through the end of the website name and the start of network

explanation.surface: A property website's network supplies everything a world could want.
explanation.walkthrough: Zoopla is a UK property-listing website, here just a string of letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A planet is a world orbiting a star, as in the many worlds of the solar system.

clue.text: Tide not advanced, regulate power of the sea …

indicators.note: the letter for advanced is not wanted, so it is left out of the tide word

parts.note: a neap is a tide of minimum range
to tune is to adjust or regulate

explanation.surface: An ocean's force: the tide held back from coming in, and kept in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Neptune is the Roman god ruling the oceans, so he is the deity whose power governs the waters.

clue.text: … Leviathan thereby righted

indicators.note: in a down entry, setting a word upright means reading it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, thereby

explanation.surface: Continuing the sea theme: the sea monster is thus set back on course.
explanation.definitionFit: A leviathan is a monstrous giant creature, and an ogre is a man-eating giant of folklore.

clue.text: Rescued broken rake

indicators.note: the letters of the first word are smashed and put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone saved a garden rake that had snapped.
explanation.walkthrough: Rake looks like the garden tool; it is the dissolute womaniser.
explanation.definitionFit: A rake is a debauched man who pursues women, the classic seducer of period fiction.

clue.text: Ensemble takes on posh place — one of five

indicators.note: the ensemble takes the other letters into itself, holding them inside

parts.note: a quintet is a musical ensemble of five
U is the old label for upper-class usage

explanation.surface: A musical group accepts a gig at a smart venue, one of five players.
explanation.definitionFit: A quintuplet is any of five babies born at one birth, so it is one of a set of five.

clue.text: Sixties pop sounds beset my ear deplorably

indicators.note: something done deplorably is done badly, so these letters come out in a muddled order

explanation.surface: The sounds of 1960s pop music grate horribly on a listener's ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Merseybeat was the Liverpool guitar-group style of the early 1960s, typified by the Beatles.

clue.text: Gallic priest's remedy?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a curé is a French parish priest
second meaning: a treatment that heals

explanation.surface: Asks what a French clergyman might prescribe for an ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: The French parish priest and the English word for a healing treatment share the same letters.

clue.text: Clear it's not in the basket?

definitions.meaning: second meaning, read literally: not put in a hamper

explanation.surface: Asks whether something is free because it was left out of the picnic basket.
explanation.walkthrough: A hamper is a lidded wicker basket, so not hampered is playfully not in one.
explanation.definitionFit: Unhampered means free from hindrance, so a way that is clear of obstacles.

clue.text: Universal screened American Idol

parts.note: a film that is screened is run, i.e. it ran

explanation.surface: A film studio broadcast the talent show American Idol.
explanation.walkthrough: Universal and American Idol suggest TV entertainment; Idol is the definition, a god.
explanation.definitionFit: Uranus was the Greek sky god, and an idol is an image worshipped as a deity.

clue.text: Changing sides — what they did in Hamelin

definitions.meaning: first meaning: deserting to the opposing party
second meaning: catching rats, the Pied Piper's job in the town of Hamelin

explanation.surface: Defecting is likened to the rodent plague of the Pied Piper legend.
explanation.definitionFit: To rat is to betray or defect, and ratting is also the hunting of rats, as in Hamelin.

clue.text: Study only edition that's revised once more

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
just means merely, only

explanation.surface: Researching a single printing that has been amended yet again.
explanation.definitionFit: To readjust something is to alter or amend it again, so readjusted means modified anew.

clue.text: In completion, much is coming up about significant letter

indicators.note: the reversed word goes round the outside of the other piece
in a down entry, coming up means reading from the bottom to the top

parts.note: a lot means much
a capital is a large letter, used where it signifies

explanation.surface: Plenty of things are emerging concerning an important letter, to finish things off.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'to cap it all' means as the final touch or culminating point, i.e. in completion.

clue.text: Feminist briefly welcome at Capital Radio?

indicators.note: shortened, so the last letter of the welcome word goes

parts.note: to greet is to welcome

indicators.note: the capital letter of a word is its first

parts.note: the first letter of radio

explanation.surface: A women's rights campaigner is greeted on a London radio station.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital Radio is a London commercial station; here Capital just picks the first letter of Radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Germaine Greer is the Australian writer of The Female Eunuch, a leading feminist of the 1970s.

clue.text: Spurge can be found regularly in Emley Rock Quarry, without question

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, the even ones of Emley Rock and then of Quarry
without question tells the solver the Q of Quarry is not taken, the abbreviation for question

explanation.surface: A weed of the spurge family can be found in a Yorkshire quarry.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the even letters of EMLEY ROCK (M, E, R, C) and of QUARRY (U, R, Y); 'without question' confirms the Q (question) is left out. Dog's mercury is a woodland plant of the spurge family.
explanation.definitionFit: This plant genus, including dog's mercury, belongs to the spurge family, so it is an example.

clue.text: Top dog and cat extremely unwell

parts.note: a mog is an informal British word for a cat

indicators.note: only the extreme letters, first and last, of the word are taken

parts.note: first and last letters of unwell

explanation.surface: The leading dog and a cat are both very poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: A mogul is a powerful magnate, the boss or most important person, so a top dog.

clue.text: Miscalculation caused by tearaway taking time out

indicators.note: time is taken out, so its letter leaves the tearaway word

parts.note: a terror is an unruly child, a tearaway

explanation.surface: A blunder made by a reckless youth who took a break.
explanation.definitionFit: An error is a mistake, and a miscalculation is a mistake in reckoning.

clue.text: Roguish prelate dismissing man

indicators.note: the chessman is sent away, removed from the prelate word

parts.note: an archbishop is a senior prelate
a bishop is a chess piece, a chessman

explanation.surface: A mischievous senior churchman sacks a subordinate.
explanation.walkthrough: Man here is a chessman; the bishop goes, leaving the start of the prelate.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch as an adjective means cheekily knowing or mischievous, as in an arch look.

clue.text: Join with good heart in duet about Love's Beginning

indicators.note: the combined letters go around the beginning of the love word
the heart of a word is its middle letters

parts.note: the two middle letters of duet

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is its beginning

parts.note: first letter of love

explanation.surface: Join a duet with good spirit about the beginning of love.
explanation.definitionFit: To glue things is to stick them together, so to join them.

clue.text: Copper's come from Paris with son

parts.note: venu is French for come, the past participle

explanation.surface: A policeman arrives from France with his boy.
explanation.walkthrough: Copper looks like a policeman; in alchemy copper was the metal of Venus.
explanation.definitionFit: Alchemists named the metals after planets, and copper was assigned to Venus.

clue.text: Wise, perhaps, when engaged in virtual reality, being capable of adjustment

indicators.note: involved within, so the name goes inside the reality letters

parts.note: Ernie Wise was half of the British comedy duo Morecambe and Wise; perhaps flags the example

explanation.surface: A wise person immersed in virtual reality can adapt.
explanation.definitionFit: A vernier is an auxiliary sliding scale or thruster used for fine adjustment of a measurement or course.

clue.text: Slyboots locked up after sermon

indicators.note: the locked-up word follows the sermon piece

parts.note: ser is a short form of sermon
pent means shut in, confined

explanation.surface: A sly person is shut away after the preacher's address.
explanation.definitionFit: A serpent is a byword for cunning, from the Eden story, so a crafty person is called one.

clue.text: Sky boss's remarkable supermajority sees Roy and Sam sadly losing out

indicators.note: unusual, so the long word's letters are rearranged
the named people's letters are lost from the mix of the long word

explanation.surface: A broadcaster's chief wins by a huge margin while two colleagues miss out.
explanation.walkthrough: Sky looks like the TV company; Jupiter was the Roman god of the sky and chief of the gods.
explanation.definitionFit: Jupiter ruled the heavens as king of the Roman gods, so he is the boss of the sky.

clue.text: Bound to attend theatre's premieres, accepted eagerly

parts.note: to bound is to leap

indicators.note: first performances, so the first letters of these words

parts.note: the first letters of these three words

explanation.surface: Obliged to go to the openings at the playhouse, someone said yes enthusiastically.
explanation.walkthrough: Bound to looks like obliged to; it is the jump.
explanation.definitionFit: To leap at an offer is to seize it with enthusiasm, an idiom for accepting eagerly.

clue.text: Drop by around lunchtime at the earliest for material

indicators.note: the visit goes around the other letter

parts.note: to pop in is to drop by briefly

indicators.note: only the earliest letter of the word is used

parts.note: first letter of lunchtime

explanation.surface: Come and visit around midday at the soonest, to see some fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Poplin is a plain-woven fabric, usually cotton, used for shirts.

clue.text: Time Lord's means of rapid rise?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ..., the god identified with Cronus, often equated with Father Time
second meaning: the ... V rocket that launched the Apollo missions

explanation.surface: Asks how Doctor Who's Time Lord ascends so quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: Time Lord suggests Doctor Who; here it is the Roman god linked with time.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturn is the deity of time and the harvest, and also the name of NASA's moon rocket.

clue.text: Couple joined up under Eye, it's said

indicators.note: spoken aloud, the pieces give the sound of the answer

parts.note: eye sounds like I, and to team is to join up; in a down entry the team sits under the I, giving I-team

explanation.surface: A pair got together beneath the watchful eye of someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people in a romantic relationship are informally called an item, i.e. a couple.

clue.text: Spoils of war — his business?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a verb meaning spoils or damages
second meaning: ..., the Roman god of war, whose trade is war

explanation.surface: Asks whether the plunder of battle belongs to some trader.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoils of war looks like one phrase meaning booty; it splits into a verb and the war god.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar is to spoil, and Mars is the Roman deity of battle.

clue.text: Leach nitre used to make solvent

indicators.note: the letters are used as material to make something new, rearranged

explanation.surface: A chemistry recipe: salt from washing is turned into a solvent.
explanation.walkthrough: Solvent looks like a chemical; it means free of debt.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in the clear is to be out of debt or danger, so solvent in the financial sense.

clue.text: Devious types go off, mostly westward

indicators.note: in an across entry, going westward means reading from right to left
most of the word, with its last letter dropped

parts.note: to go off is to fall asleep, so sleep

explanation.surface: Untrustworthy people head off, mostly towards the west.
explanation.definitionFit: Eels are slippery creatures, so slippery or devious people are likened to them.

clue.text: Looking back, St Omer seen hazily intervening in distance

indicators.note: coming between, so the jumbled letters go inside
facing backwards, so the town name is read in reverse
seen hazily means blurred, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Glancing behind at a French town, glimpsed through mist far away.
explanation.walkthrough: St Omer is a town in northern France.
explanation.definitionFit: Remoteness is the state of being far away, so it means distance or aloofness.
